reviewed_sources.author: S. Krasnikov
reviewed_sources.title: Electrostatic interaction of a pointlike charge with a wormhole
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Prescribed ultrastatic two-end geometry and field equation on PDF page 3; flux/uniqueness discussion on pages 4-5; complete Section 2 multipole equations, proposition, proof and three corollaries on pages 5-8. The self-force calculation in Section 3 and later editions were not reviewed here.
reviewed_sources.proof_interpretation: For l>0 a nonzero homogeneous solution cannot be bounded at both ends. The growth statement is read as growth at at least one end; it does not say that every nonzero linear combination grows at both ends.
reviewed_sources.independent_check: Putting z=r*phi in the displayed homogeneous equation gives (r^2 phi')'-l(l+1)phi=0. A solution bounded at both flat ends has the decaying l>0 branch there. Integration against phi has vanishing boundary terms and forces the positive radial/angular energy to vanish. The differential transformation is checked symbolically.
reviewed_sources.use_and_boundary: Established flux-sector uniqueness and absence of freely adjustable source-free higher multipole charges. The current geometry has two mouths in one common exterior, and the induced nonspherical multipoles are determined by its fixed flux and transmission data. The source's electrostatic theorem is not imported as the coupled magnetic existence theorem.

identified_not_proof_reviewed.scope: Primary abstract and metadata identified. No equation, throat regularity claim, or novelty conclusion is imported without the full proof review.

search_triage: Search returns also included material magnetic cloaks, nonlinear electrodynamics and two-dimensional wormholes. Those different physical models were not substituted for the selected magnetic Einstein-Maxwell/Dirac program. The existing MMP construction and its baseline scales remain the physical comparator.
analytic_inputs: Positive Dirichlet energy minimization, the coercive variational theorem, standard energy trace/extension and local Maxwell elliptic regularity. The actual two-ball exterior and spherical throat forms, uniform annular coercivity, coupled transmission equation and q,p error estimates are supplied explicitly in the new note.
result: Source-free magnetostatic completion on the prescribed smooth geometry, with squared field correction O(q^2 p^3) and classical energy correction O(q^2 p^3/(g^2 d)). The p=q^-1 bound does not establish smallness relative to q/ell; p=q^-3/2 does in the retained weak-coupling family.
verification_boundary: Actual exterior translated multipoles are coupled to continuous throat BVP maps, independently compared with finite elements. Truncation, angular quadrature, flux residuals and exact algebra are checked. This is supplementary numerical evidence, not validated numerics or an Einstein/quantum-field simulation.
decision: Continue the physical long-return damping primary and matched finite-duration band-transfer fallback. The artificial Maxwell seam current is removed on the prescribed metric. Next control the corrected connection in the full Dirac operator and the local stress/metric response. Neither physical endpoint nor publication novelty is accepted.
remaining: Corrected channel mixing and return/source derivatives, local stress and Einstein backreaction, quantum state and renormalized response including exterior determinant and discarded tail, full novelty review, consequential endpoint, independent verification, GCP-only certification and manuscript.
